name: io.github.domondi1/inferrail-web-read
title: Inferrail Web Read
description: Web pages as clean markdown for $0.002 each over x402: hosted, or local with your wallet.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one public web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown (title, main text, headings, lists, links, tables) with the page's metadata (description, canonical URL, authors, published date, language), word count and a content hash. Paid per delivered page over x402; a blocked, missing, failing or refused page (including a bot check or a page with no text without JavaScript) costs nothing.
